qa_pair.question: In the Notion database "Eval: Projects", consider only projects whose Status is "In progress". Which owner has the largest total Budget across those projects? Answer with the owner's first name.

Projects in "Eval: Projects" are linked to clients in "Eval: Clients", and each client has a Tier. Among projects tagged "Security", which client tier has the most projects? Answer with the tier name.
The page "Eval: Q3 retro" records a decision about the queue migration inside a collapsed section. Who approved it? Answer with the person's full name.
According to the metrics table on the page "Eval: Q3 retro", what was the p95 latency in September 2025, in milliseconds? Answer with the number only.
In the "Eval: Projects" database, how many Status options belong to the "Complete" status group? Answer with a number.
The "Eval: Projects" database has a board view. Which property are its columns grouped by? Answer with the property name.
How many projects in "Eval: Projects" have a Due date in the third quarter of 2025 (July 1 to September 30, 2025, inclusive)? Answer with a number.
The page "Eval: Runbook" has a collapsible section titled "Restart the worker" containing a code block. What language is that code block set to? Answer in lowercase.
There is an open comment on the page "Eval: Runbook". Which single word in it is bold? Answer with that word in lowercase.

Consider every project in "Eval: Projects" whose client (in "Eval: Clients") is in the EMEA region. What is the median Budget of those projects, in US dollars? Answer as a whole number without symbols or separators.
